candidate_windows.window_text:
In this study, we conduct a systematic evaluation of various MLLMs, including 38 open-source and

seven proprietary models, to assess their performance on the Agri-CM<sup>3</sup> benchmark. All evaluations are conducted in a zero-shot setting, meaning that the models do not receive any example prompts during reasoning and have not been trained explicitly on tasks related to the benchmark. This approach allows us to measure the generalization ability of MLLMs in agricultural pest and disease management and evaluate their reasoning capabilities on unseen tasks. All experiments are executed on 4 NVIDIA H800 GPUs (80GB memory). Detailed experimental settings and hyperparameter configurations are provided in the Appendix B.

For closed-source models, we directly call the corresponding APIs. For open-source models, if the model supports vLLM $^3$ , we deploy it in the OpenAI API format and test it according to the API call procedure. If the model does not support vLLM, we use the official inference method provided by the model developers to perform reasoning. During the evaluation, to ensure the stability of the results, we set the temperature parameter to 0.0 and the maximum output length to 1024.

See Prompt B.1, B.3, B.5 for the prompts in the experiment. The English Prompt after translation is B.2, B.4, and B.6.
